body: I just found out that Amazon is selling Everything Must Change for $8.80. That’s the lowest price I’ve seen for hardcover … I continue to hear good reports from people using the book for reading groups, small groups, church and seminary classes, etc., around the world. Might be a good time to stock up for a group this fall …
